content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a 0-10V differential pressure sensor that measures up to 0-5 inches of water gauge ("wg"). I want to display the measured value with two decimal place accuracy, such as showing 0.89"wg. I'm having trouble getting the scaling set up to show values accurately enough. Could anyone offer some advice? Best regards, [user_name]
Could you clarify what "0-5"wg" refers to? Also, does '2dp' mean two decimal places?
Yes, '2dp' stands for two decimal places. 'wg' means inches of water gauge (or water column).
Please refer to the attached file for additional information.
